title: I Built a Fully Automated Social Media Publisher with Claude Code. No more Paying
description:
Claude Code social media publisher build — how I replaced Buffer and Repurpose.io by building my own automated social media publisher with Claude Code that publishes to YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook, and TikTok with optimised captions, tags, and scheduling.

I was paying monthly for Buffer and Repurpose.io to schedule and publish posts across platforms. Then I used Claude Code to build my own social media publisher in one session and cancelled all of them. I give Claude Code my content package including the script, optimised descriptions, tags, hashtags, and the time I want each post to go live, and it publishes automatically to every platform with all the right captions already in there. I own the whole thing. There is no monthly fee. Claude Code built it and I just run it.

In this video:
→ How I built a social media publisher with Claude Code that replaced Buffer and Repurpose.io
→ What I feed into Claude Code to trigger automatic publishing across all platforms
→ How it publishes to YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook, and TikTok with optimised captions automatically
→ Why owning your automation beats paying for scheduling tools every month
→ How to build your own social media publisher with Claude Code in one session
